interpretation: Descriptive historical scoring of forced decisions on the original forecast window; not a prospective or independent validation of predictive ability.
limitations: 27 selected historical NVIDIA cases; not an independent or prospective validation sample.
Historical model knowledge cannot be eliminated by instructions.
Same dates and overlapping windows make some observations dependent.
Missing expectations and pre-decision market context are unchanged from the original experiment.
Three-way probabilities are new outputs, not renormalized four-way outputs.
No model-reported probability is assumed calibrated by this small sample.
